components.text: Whether libertarian alternative possibility requires multiple objectively branching futures with the actual past and laws fixed.

response.rationale: The reply directly rejects the branching-future requirement and relocates alternatives to relevantly similar possible worlds.

precisionFindings.rationale: Sourcehood and possible-world alternatives are recoverable, but the set of relevant features held fixed is left flexible and partly unsettled.

calibrationFindings.rationale: The possibility claim is plausible, but it does not specify constraints sufficient to avoid trivial alternatives generated by changing decisive antecedents.

charity.alternative: The consequence argument asks about alternatives with the actual past and laws fixed, not merely alternatives somewhere in modal space.
charity.decisiveQualification: A relevant-world account must justify which actual features may vary without trivializing the ability to do otherwise.

immutablePublicationFields.words: Libertarian freedom combines agential sourcehood with relevant alternative possibilities, but those alternatives may obtain across suitably similar possible worlds without requiring an objectively branching future.
